subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) He had ammunition business at Leningrad. (b) He undertook plan to give an award for encouraging the creative work. (c) Dr. Alfred Nobel was born on 21st October, 1833 at Stockholm, Sweden., (d) He earned a lot of money from his dynamite business. (e) He was an engineer. (f) His father Emanuel Nobel was an architect and researcher. (g) In 1850 Alfred joined his father’s company. (h) After some years Alfred Nobel invented dynamite.
guide_solution: c → e → f → a → g → h → d → b
